items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Funny thing about him Ben Sparks he was great big guy and he was always talking about one of these days a strong wind would blow him over and he would never get up any more. He outlived Benny many years.

ctx.x: HOW WAS HE? WAS HE HARD TO GET ALONG WITH?
No, everybody thought he had tuberculosis, he looked like he was (inaudible).
